digest.component_or_area: completion verifier, resume mechanism, verdict caching
propositions: Passing prior-attempt search frontier as an exclusion-list data block inside the untrusted ticket context fence does not reduce re-search overlap: treatment arm showed +60% to +78% relative increase in overlap repeats vs control across both test tickets
Fence-inert frontier block acts as a signpost rather than exclusion: model repeatedly re-read files explicitly listed in the frontier block, raising measured overlap instead of preventing it

Exclusion-list approach failed predeclared decision rule on both tickets (>=30% overlap reduction required on every ticket); attempts-to-clean met criterion but overlap increases disqualified the treatment

Cache-seeding via verdict deduplication already removes the dominant redundancy (re-proving credited criteria); remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be effectively suppressed by data-shaped boundary hints in an untrusted context fence
